items.criterion: A definition or data difference identified that accounts for the gap, or a documented reason it cannot be settled

items.title: DV-1 precision > 0.80 at >= 50% coverage, both families, held out (landmark ER-2)
items.criterion: Lower end of the scenario-cluster 95% interval of DV-1 precision of the selective view at >= 0.50 coverage > 0.80 on the CausalArena test split, semantic and formula (docs/decisions/2026-10-14_q2_landmarks.md)
items.note: v2 (B4, first read): semantic 0.812 [0.756], formula 0.899 [0.854]. v3 (second read, 125 files per family): semantic 0.830 [0.783], formula 0.908 [0.876] (met for formula); pooled 5,000 rows: semantic 0.866 [0.799] (short by 0.001), formula 0.911 [0.863]. Not met: semantic's lower end is below 0.80 in both regimes. Semantic is capped by missed links (analysis/reports/q2_v3_k1_k2_dev.md section 3). 16 Oct (dev): two link filters (triangle order, resampling stability) earn a licence on formula (cut precision 0.81; 25% / 38% of false links cut) and not on semantic, where 55% of true links sit beside a real mediated path; neither can act until an applicability condition exists (analysis/reports/q2_linkfilt_dev.md). 19 Oct (dev): L16, an observable gate (ledger density or triangle share) clears the pooled bar (0.803, 20% of false links) only by acting at a stricter cut-off on denser files; it fails the transfer guard (within-family rho <= 0.33) and its semantic cuts are right 0.735, so it is not acted on. A declared domain-structure statement licensing L8a costs -0.002 DV-1 precision when wrong (analysis/reports/q2_l16_dev.md). L5, interventions as link evidence: no licence; the shadow signal is real (48% vs 7%) but CausalArena's release reaches 20% / 13% of false links with about 40 rows per target (analysis/reports/q2_l5_dev.md). 20 Oct (wave A, dev): explanation round X1-X3 (analysis/reports/q2_explain_dev.md). Both semantic gaps come from a linear-Gaussian score on nonlinear / discrete mechanisms: given the true graph the score still wants 78% of shadow links and 76% of the missed search-gap links, while GES's graph outscores the true graph on 117 of 120 files. Pre-registered rule: D2-search; read with the global check, the lever is the score (post-hoc reading, labelled). Floor confirmed real (X3). Second held-out family pre-registered (plans/v3_prereg_amendment_1_family2.json).

items.title: Accuracy landmark ER-4a: data-only F1 above GES (route A), or knowledge tiers lift > 0.03 (route B)
items.criterion: Route A: kernel D minus GES directed F1, lower end > 0 on one family; route B: D+K minus D (real names), lower end > 0.03 on one family; held out
items.note: Measured, not met (v2). v3 dev: route A still ties GES even with 5,000 rows (C3 0.551 vs GES 0.559, semantic pooled); a lower GES penalty lowers F1 (0.522 -> 0.466). Route B: Meek propagation from knowledge adds +0.001; the oracle ceiling of the orient-only rule is +0.060 / +0.044. Needs direction evidence beyond the equivalence class (v4). 16 Oct: route A through pairwise asymmetry is closed at 1,000 rows on CausalArena (analysis/reports/q2_dirsig_dev.md); open direction sources are interventions and knowledge. 19 Oct: adding missed links from interventions (L5 rule A) is 9-14% precise on dev; no licence (analysis/reports/q2_l5_dev.md). 20 Oct (wave A, dev): X2, semantic reversals are 49% skeleton-caused, 38% rule-caused, 13% left open on the true skeleton (formula 62 / 29 / 9) (analysis/reports/q2_explain_dev.md).

items.criterion: Two published rows per cell line (K562, RPE1) reproduced within tolerance before any re-score claim; then per published method: (a) edge-placement control on mean Wasserstein and FOR; (b) names-only baseline on the biological and statistical evaluations under a gene-label permutation; the share of each published score each channel accounts for, with intervals; predictions and thresholds hashed before the first re-score
items.note: Opened 19 Oct from the CausalBench deep-dive (project:claude/benchmark-targets.md, update 2026-10-19). Data download and long runs on Uzair's machine; the names-only arm needs a small approved model spend. First step toward Rung 3 (evidence-typed, calibrated pairs) and the large real testbed for lever L5. 20 Oct (wave A): S0-S2 built and pre-registered (plans/ben13_prereg.json). CausalBench's preprocessing is streamed in row chunks (peak about 0.5 GB instead of about 30 GB) and equals causalbench 1.1.2's arrays bit for bit on synthetic files; evaluation through causalbench's own classes (all-path tests skipped, checked equal by a canary cell). Names-only LLM arm not run (decision D-3 = no): the names channel is measured with literature networks and gene-label permutations.
